title: Qwen3-Next: Towards Ultimate Training & Inference Efficiency
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型发布报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计开放权重模型中架构和权重披露与后训练数据、反馈和复现证据之间的边界
one_line: Qwen3-Next releases Instruct and Thinking weights and reports 15T pretraining plus GSPO-assisted RL, but does not disclose post-training prompts, rewards or verifiers, rollout groups, filters, or audit records.
Qwen3-Next 发布了 Instruct 与 Thinking 权重，并披露了 15T 预训练及以 GSPO 改善 RL 稳定性的高层信息；但后训练数据、奖励/验证器、rollout、过滤和审计记录均未公开。
why: It is a high-impact disclosure case in which architecture, inference code, and model weights are inspectable while the data and feedback required to reproduce or audit reasoning post-training remain unavailable.
inclusion_reason: Official Qwen frontier release that discloses a 15T pretraining subset, post-trained Instruct and Thinking weights, and high-level GSPO use while leaving the post-training data and feedback ledger materially opaque.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official Qwen release dated September 10, 2025 exposes a model architecture, aggregate pretraining scale, post-trained weights, and benchmark tables, but not the post-training records or feedback needed to reconstruct the reasoning pipeline. A named RL algorithm and downloadable weights are not themselves a disclosure of prompts, candidate responses, rewards, verifiers, rollout groups, or selection decisions.

Qwen3-Next belongs in the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger as a partial-disclosure case. Its public data object is principally an aggregate statement that the base model used a uniformly sampled 15T-token subset of Qwen3's 36T-token pretraining corpus; the post-training data object remains unknown.

Qwen 于 2025 年 9 月 10 日发布的官方材料公开了模型架构、聚合层面的预训练规模、后训练权重和 benchmark 表格，却未公开重建推理流水线所需的后训练记录与反馈。点名一种 RL 算法并提供可下载权重，本身并不构成对提示词、候选响应、奖励、验证器、rollout 分组或选择决策的披露。

Qwen3-Next 适合作为“前沿报告与数据披露账本”中的部分披露案例。其公开的数据对象主要是一条聚合陈述：基础模型使用了从 Qwen3 的 36T-token 预训练语料中均匀采样的 15T-token 子集；后训练数据对象仍为 unknown。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official Qwen release describes Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B as an 80B-total-parameter model with about 3B activated parameters. It reports hybrid Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention layers, a highly sparse MoE, stability-oriented normalization and routing changes, and Multi-Token Prediction. It also announces post-trained Instruct and Thinking variants.

For post-training, the release says GSPO addressed RL stability and efficiency problems associated with the hybrid-attention, high-sparsity MoE architecture. The separately linked GSPO source defines Group Sequence Policy Optimization through sequence-likelihood importance ratios and sequence-level clipping, rewarding, and optimization over response groups. That generic algorithm description does not identify the Qwen3-Next prompts, rewards, verifiers, group size, rollouts, filters, or retained process records.

The category rationale is therefore disclosure auditing, not a claim that Qwen3-Next releases a reasoning dataset or reusable RLVR recipe.

Qwen 官方发布页将 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B 描述为总参数量 80B、激活参数约 3B 的模型。页面报告了混合 Gated DeltaNet 与 Gated Attention 层、高稀疏 MoE、面向稳定性的归一化与路由改动，以及 Multi-Token Prediction，并宣布了后训练的 Instruct 与 Thinking 变体。

就后训练而言，发布页称 GSPO 解决了混合注意力和高稀疏 MoE 架构相关的 RL 稳定性与效率问题。其另行链接的 GSPO 来源将 Group Sequence Policy Optimization 定义为：对响应分组采用基于序列似然的重要性比率，以及序列级 clipping、rewarding 和 optimization。这个通用算法描述并未给出 Qwen3-Next 的提示词、奖励、验证器、组大小、rollout、过滤规则或保留的过程记录。

因此，本卡的分类理由是披露审计，而不是声称 Qwen3-Next 发布了推理数据集或可复用的 RLVR 配方。

title: Method
方法
html:
The release describes the pretraining input only as a uniform 15T-token sample from Qwen3's 36T-token corpus. It does not provide the source mixture, document identifiers, source rights, data revisions, filters, deduplication, contamination controls, or retained record schema. The reported lineage is therefore limited to Qwen3 corpus, sampled pretraining subset, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Base, and the Instruct and Thinking post-trained variants.

The Thinking model repository states “Pretraining (15T tokens) & Post-training,” exposes weights and configuration under Apache-2.0, and supplies inference instructions. The Instruct repository does the same for the non-thinking variant. The model cards state that Qwen3-Next inference support was merged into Hugging Face Transformers; this makes the inference architecture inspectable, not the original training pipeline.

For RL, the release names GSPO and the generic GSPO source supplies a sequence-level objective over queries and grouped responses. No accepted source specifies the Qwen3-Next query set, response generator, teacher, reward or verifier, judge, group construction, terminal predicate, advantage computation, loss coefficients, rollout count, decoding settings, optimizer, schedule, checkpoint selection, or training environment. Those fields remain unknown.

The Thinking model card recommends a maximum output length of 32,768 tokens for most queries and 81,920 for complex mathematics or programming benchmarks. These are inference and benchmark settings, not evidence about training-time rollout budgets.

发布页只将预训练输入描述为从 Qwen3 的 36T-token 语料中均匀采样的 15T-token 子集，没有提供来源混合、文档标识、来源权利、数据版本、过滤、去重、污染控制或保留记录 schema。因此，可报告的 lineage 仅限于 Qwen3 语料、采样得到的预训练子集、Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Base，以及后训练的 Instruct 与 Thinking 变体。

Thinking 模型仓库标注“Pretraining (15T tokens) & Post-training”，以 Apache-2.0 提供权重与配置，并给出推理说明。Instruct 仓库对 non-thinking 变体提供相应工件。模型卡称 Qwen3-Next 的推理支持已合入 Hugging Face Transformers；这使推理架构可检查，但不等于原始训练流水线可检查。

在 RL 方面，发布页点名 GSPO，而通用 GSPO 来源给出了基于 query 与分组响应的序列级目标。已接受来源均未说明 Qwen3-Next 的 query 集、响应生成器、teacher、奖励或验证器、judge、分组构造、终止条件、优势计算、损失系数、rollout 数量、解码设置、优化器、日程、检查点选择或训练环境。这些字段均保留为 unknown。

Thinking 模型卡建议多数 query 使用 32,768-token 最大输出长度，复杂数学或编程 benchmark 使用 81,920。这些是推理与 benchmark 设置，不是训练时 rollout 预算的证据。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official blog supports the release date and identity, the 80B-total/about-3B-active architecture, the uniform 15T pretraining sample, the two post-trained variants, and the statement that GSPO was used to improve RL stability and efficiency. The official model repositories support the released-weight identity, configuration, inference guidance, and Apache-2.0 release license. The linked GSPO source supports only the generic sequence-level algorithm description.

The blog and model cards report benchmark and throughput comparisons for Base, Instruct, and Thinking variants. Those results evaluate model behavior and efficiency under reported settings; they do not establish that the hidden post-training prompts, traces, rewards, filters, or selected samples are accurate, diverse, uncontaminated, or reusable. Benchmark performance is not evidence of data quality.

No Qwen3-Next-specific official arXiv or venue paper, training-data release, training repository, DOI, or BibTeX record was identified. The model cards cite the distinct Qwen3 Technical Report, so this entry treats the Qwen3-Next blog and repositories as a frontier release rather than implying a peer-reviewed paper.

官方博客支持发布日期与身份、总参数量 80B/激活参数约 3B 的架构、均匀采样的 15T 预训练子集、两个后训练变体，以及使用 GSPO 改善 RL 稳定性与效率的表述。官方模型仓库支持已发布权重的身份、配置、推理建议和 Apache-2.0 发布许可。链接的 GSPO 来源只支持通用的序列级算法描述。

博客和模型卡报告了 Base、Instruct 与 Thinking 变体的 benchmark 和吞吐量比较。这些结果评估的是模型在所报告设置下的行为与效率，不能证明隐藏的后训练提示词、轨迹、奖励、过滤或入选样本准确、多样、无污染或可复用。Benchmark 性能不是数据质量证据。

未识别到 Qwen3-Next 专属的官方 arXiv 或会议论文、训练数据发布、训练仓库、DOI 或 BibTeX 记录。模型卡引用的是不同的 Qwen3 Technical Report，因此本条目把 Qwen3-Next 博客与模型仓库视为前沿发布材料，而不暗示其为同行评审论文。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The release's concrete technical novelty is architectural: it combines Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention, increases MoE sparsity, adds stability-oriented design changes, and uses Multi-Token Prediction. At the post-training level, it connects GSPO to stabilizing RL for this hybrid sparse architecture. The generic GSPO contribution predates the Qwen3-Next release and should not be presented as a newly specified Qwen3-Next data recipe.

For the atlas, the direction signal is the mismatch between artifact visibility and training-ledger visibility. Model weights, configurations, and inference code are inspectable, while post-training examples, feedback records, and audit manifests are not. The 15T statement is useful aggregate pretraining evidence, but it is neither a corpus manifest nor evidence about how the Instruct and Thinking post-training data were constructed.

该发布的具体技术新意主要在架构层面：组合 Gated DeltaNet 与 Gated Attention、提高 MoE 稀疏度、加入面向稳定性的设计改动，并使用 Multi-Token Prediction。在后训练层面，它把 GSPO 与稳定这一混合稀疏架构的 RL 训练联系起来。通用 GSPO 工作早于 Qwen3-Next 发布，不应被表述成新近公开的 Qwen3-Next 数据配方。

对本图谱而言，方向信号来自工件可见性与训练账本可见性之间的不匹配：模型权重、配置和推理代码可检查，而后训练样本、反馈记录和审计清单不可检查。15T 表述是有用的聚合预训练证据，但它既不是语料清单，也不能证明 Instruct 与 Thinking 的后训练数据如何构造。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The 15T pretraining disclosure omits source composition, document provenance, per-source permissions, revisions, filters, deduplication, decontamination, and train/evaluation split controls. Apache-2.0 covers the released repository artifacts; it does not establish rights to the training sources or synthetic outputs.

Post-training prompts, candidate responses, thinking traces, preference or correctness labels, rejected samples, group membership, counts, mixtures, and immutable manifests are not released. The Qwen3-Next-specific reward source, verifier or judge contract, terminal predicate, calibration, error analysis, rollout policy, sampling settings, optimizer, coefficients, schedule, compute, and intermediate checkpoints are unknown.

The generic GSPO objective cannot fill these gaps because the Qwen3-Next instantiation is not documented. Benchmark tables also combine architecture, pretraining, post-training, reward design, and inference-budget effects, so they cannot isolate data quality or the contribution of any one stage. Lack of a Qwen3-Next-specific archival paper, training code, data release, and benchmark-overlap audit further limits reproducibility.

15T 预训练披露没有给出来源组成、文档 provenance、逐来源权限、版本、过滤、去重、去污染以及训练/评测划分控制。Apache-2.0 覆盖已发布的仓库工件，但不能确立训练来源或合成输出的权利。

后训练提示词、候选响应、思维轨迹、偏好或正确性标签、被拒样本、分组归属、数量、混合和不可变清单均未发布。Qwen3-Next 特定的奖励来源、验证器或 judge 契约、终止条件、校准、错误分析、rollout 策略、采样设置、优化器、系数、日程、训练计算量和中间检查点均为 unknown。

通用 GSPO 目标无法填补这些缺口，因为 Qwen3-Next 的具体实例没有文档。Benchmark 表格还混合了架构、预训练、后训练、奖励设计和推理预算的影响，因此不能分离数据质量或任一阶段的贡献。缺少 Qwen3-Next 专属归档论文、训练代码、数据发布和 benchmark 重叠审计，也进一步限制了可复现性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger, this card is useful for separating three layers that are often conflated: runnable model artifacts, a generic RL algorithm description, and the unreleased model-specific training ledger. It supports comparisons with other frontier reports by recording exactly which data, feedback, construction, and audit fields are disclosed or unknown.

For post-training research, the release can motivate an audit schema but cannot populate a reusable dataset. A sufficient future record would preserve prompt sources, candidate responses and thinking traces, reward or verifier outputs, group identifiers, filtering and rejection reasons, GSPO settings, rollout logs, checkpoints, source rights, splits, decontamination results, and benchmark-overlap evidence. Deployment output limits should remain separate from training rollout budgets.

在“前沿报告与数据披露账本”中，本卡可用于区分三个经常被混为一谈的层次：可运行的模型工件、通用 RL 算法描述，以及未发布的模型特定训练账本。它通过精确记录哪些数据、反馈、构造与审计字段已经披露或仍为 unknown，支持与其他前沿报告比较。

对后训练研究而言，该发布可以启发审计 schema，却不能直接提供可复用数据集。充分的未来记录应保留提示词来源、候选响应与思维轨迹、奖励或验证器输出、分组标识、过滤与拒绝原因、GSPO 设置、rollout 日志、检查点、来源权利、划分、去污染结果和 benchmark 重叠证据。部署输出限制应与训练 rollout 预算分开记录。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the 15T statement as aggregate pretraining evidence, not a corpus manifest or post-training-data release.
  • Qwen releases Instruct and Thinking weights, configuration, and inference guidance; it does not release the training ledger.
  • GSPO supplies a generic sequence-level RL objective, but the Qwen3-Next reward, verifier, groups, and rollout settings remain unknown.
  • Keep the 32,768 and 81,920 output recommendations separate from training-time rollout budgets.
  • Benchmark and throughput gains evaluate the released models; they do not prove data or feedback quality.

• 将 15T 表述视为聚合预训练证据，而不是语料清单或后训练数据发布。
  • Qwen 发布了 Instruct 与 Thinking 权重、配置和推理建议，但没有发布训练账本。
  • GSPO 提供通用的序列级 RL 目标，但 Qwen3-Next 的奖励、验证器、分组和 rollout 设置仍为 unknown。
  • 将 32,768 与 81,920 的输出建议和训练时 rollout 预算分开记录。
  • Benchmark 与吞吐量提升评估的是已发布模型，不能证明数据或反馈质量。
